main_text.p: Cap 7.¶2. Obijcitur, Atqui Patres voluerunt in terram promissam transferri, & Iosephı de ofsibus suis dedit singulare mandatum Gen.49 50.Iof.24 R. Nihil hoc superstitiosis illis patrocinari. 1.Fidei opus fuit, (Hebr.11) qua respexerunt in promissiones,Gen.12 15.17. 46.2. Posteris exemplū præbuerunt, vt ipsi quoque de reditu cogitarent, & egressi semel non redirent in Ægyptum. Quod quàm necessarium fuerit,apparet ex ijs quæ post acciderunt, Exod.14.16.Num.11.14.20 21.&c.Item Iere. 42.43.Difcamus bonitatem Dei agnoscere,qui mortem Filij merito vicit,vt nobis transitus sit ad vitam æternā, Ioh.5.Rom. 8.14.In hoc constantes,Oremus.
main_text.head: HOMILIA L.
main_text.p: 17 Cum autē appropinquaret tempus promissionis,quam iurauerat Deus Abrahamo,creuit populus,& multiplicatus est in Ægypto.
18 Vsque quo exortus est alius rex, qui non nouerat Iosephı
19 Hic aduersus genus nostrum in geniosus, malè acceperunt Patres nostros, adeò vt exponerent infantes suos neso bolesciere.

page.notes: Top of page: "Cap 7." is a marginal note at left. Section 2 paragraph is long and set in a narrow column; the first line of the homily heading "HOMILIA L." is partly obscured. Marginal reference "20" with word "Quo" is set apart at lower right and is treated as running text; the bottom part of the page is faint. Some words are doubtful: "Vsque", "Quo", "bolesciere" (scan reads "bolefcerent").
